scenarios.name: Cancel a staged command on the View ribbon target

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the View ribbon tab is selected
the Part | View custom target is empty
the user opens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in All Commands
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part | View target
the target is marked as changed
the user reopens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu
the Part | View target is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in All Commands
